instruction: Append the text 'COPIED' to file 'log.txt' in each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 && mkdir dir1 dir2 dir3 && echo 'Log entry 1' > dir1/log.txt && echo 'Log entry 2' > dir2/log.txt && echo 'Log entry 3' > dir3/log.txt

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if grep -q "COPIED" "$d/log.txt" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Success: COPIED appended to log.txt in $d."; else echo "Failure: COPIED not found in log.txt in $d."; fi; done'
